name: Matches, by season, model or owner (a member's)
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-matches-list: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to its participants, its season admins and platform admins (season_visible), and to anyone else exactly as the public route does. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. One statement, three listings: a season's matches, one version's history (?model=), or every match a person's versions played (?owner=), each row match_summary_json(), the card every channel returns. A TRIAL IS PUBLIC ONLY ONCE ITS CANDIDATE IS (match_public, the stored `listed`): the season and owner listings leave trials out, and a query naming the model or version returns its public ones; the rest are GET /v1/me/matches. Each sort is its own branch with its own KEYSET cursor on (key, id), and only the asked one runs, so a season-wide sort reads its page off its partial index rather than sorting the season; a row with no key (a shared first has no margin) is outside that sort. `discussed` ranks by live comments in the `since` window and pages by OFFSET, because a live count moves under a keyset. The seat filters (`model`, `version`, `owner`, `vs`, `top`) are sets of matches read off match_seats, so a model's listing and its total cost the model's matches. `total` is counted on the first page only and stops at 10,000 (`total_capped`), because it is the one part that must scan.

body.detail: `sort` is newest, closest, upset, longest or discussed.
`vs` names the other model of a head to head, beside `model`.

with.name: A head to head names both models
